name: net-identity
description: Firefox network identity manager that keeps proxy, public IP, geolocation, timezone, and WebRTC behavior consistent.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint:ext
scripts.dev: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --browser-console
scripts.package: npm run build:prod && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest && node scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs
